_about: Strings of the Production section. The shared route list is in the core catalogue (routes.*).
work.title: Production
work.about: The work the base exists for: write an artifact, check someone's story, assemble a closing document and hand it outward. Maintaining the base itself is on the Routines tab.
work.outcome: The outcome: a finished document in the folder of its type, built on verified knowledge and remembering what it was built on (based_on). The base itself does not change — here it is read.
work.idea_ph: The task in your own words: which feature or requirement the document is for
work.kinds_failed: artifact types could not be read: {why}
work.kinds_none: the project declares no types — «Project settings» → «Artifacts»
work.spec_no_out: ⚠️ no folder set — nowhere to put it
work.publish_hint: pick a finished document and send it as a child page
work.publish_no_url: this type has no publishing address — «Project settings» → «Artifacts»
work.making: enriching from the base and asking the model…
work.enough_hint: build the plan from what is already known
work.publish_empty: The folder of this type is empty — create a document first, then publish.
work.publish_note_ph: a note for the assistant before publishing (optional)
work.publish_draft_warn: ⚠️ the document is a draft: the chain was not finished — the critic or Momus were left behind
work.publish_again: a clean copy already exists: {url} — publishing will update that page
work.publish_new: a new child page will be created
work.publish_draft_ask:
The document did not pass the chain to the end (status: draft).

What is published becomes where the clean copy lives — the team will see it.

Publish anyway?
work.publish_task: Publish {rel} to Confluence as a child page.
work.publish_task_tail: The document type settings are /aurora-vault make:kinds.
work.task_copied: The task is copied — paste it to the assistant
work.task_clipboard_off: The clipboard is unavailable — copy it from the console
work.refs_hint: @ — a project file or folder and an MCP server, / — a skill; you can attach a text file (.md, .txt, .json, .py…)
work.attach_text_only: “{name}” — only text files can be attached
work.attach_too_big: “{name}” is over 1 MB — that is no longer context
